body:
did you know: midnights was secretly two surprises in one night.

the album dropped at midnight -- 13 songs taylor called "a complete concept album... a full picture of the intensities of that mystifying, mad hour." she'd teased "a special very chaotic surprise" earlier in the evening, and nobody knew what it meant.

then at 3am eastern -- midnight on the west coast -- seven more songs just appeared. the great war, bigger than the whole sky, paris, high infidelity, glitch, would've could've should've, and dear reader. about twenty-five more minutes of album, out of nowhere.

she called them the "3am tracks" -- the ones from the journey to find that magic 13 -- written mostly with jack antonoff and aaron dessner, the folklore/evermore architect. her reason was simple: "lately, i've been loving the feeling of sharing more of our creative process with you."

so if your favorite midnights song is a 3am one, remember: it almost stayed a secret.
